messages:
deploybot: [DEPLOYBOT] Canary for text-gen in us-east-2 failing readiness on 4/6 canaries, 11% 5xx, rollout paused automatically. Requesting expedited decision: pin to redwood/text-gen:v5.0.2 or allow rollback to v5.0.1.

nora: I'm seeing customer errors in logs. Need quick decision — this is inside our change window.

diego: probable regression from new tokenization fallback in v5.0.2. Repro on staging. Vote: pin to v5.0.1-stable and scale down canary.

ops_lead: I can execute the pin and supervise. If pinned, monitor for 10m then clear. If errors persist >5% after 10m, we'll trigger full rollback and open incident channel.

nora: I'll draft a terse release note for the pin. QA, can you double-check no lingering canary traffic? @qa_bot

qa_bot: Quick check: no user traffic hitting v5.0.2 after last health probe. Canary scaled to zero. Verifying metrics.

diego: running pin command:
```
/releasebot pin --service text-gen --image redwood/text-gen:v5.0.1-stable --reason "canary regressions v5.0.2 tokenization fallback" --urgency expedited --owner diego
```

releasebot: Pin command accepted. Validating image signatures and deploy policy... OK. Applying pin and rebalancing traffic (ETA ~30s).

deploybot: Reroute complete. All traffic on redwood/text-gen:v5.0.1-stable. v5.0.2 canaries terminated.

qa_bot: Metrics: error_rate back to baseline ~0.4%, p99 latency normal. No remaining canary pods.

ops_lead: Monitoring for 15m per policy. Will page SRE if anomaly >5%.

nora: Drafted internal note: "Expedited pin to v5.0.1 due to canary tokenization regressions in v5.0.2. Investigations assigned to diego. Postmortem to follow." Link: https://redwood.internal/releases/notes/1801010101

diego: starting bisect on tokenization changes and will run reproduce in a scaled staging cluster.

ops_lead: +18m stable, no regression. Closing expedite window and marking resolved. Logging as expedited pin per release policy. :white_check_mark:
